propositions: A verified description write (14,997 chars) reported success and passed read-back verification, then silently reverted to an older revision (10,582 chars) without error or conflict signal.
Optimistic concurrency did not reject or loudly fail the losing write despite documenting that conflicting writes should raise ConcurrencyError/exit 10.
The ticket was being edited while its own plan-review was running and emitting REVIEW_RESULT sidecar events, suggesting store reconvergence between concurrent writers as the trigger.
Read-back verification is insufficient protection because the data passed verification immediately after write but was lost afterwards.
A later write to the same ticket with no review in flight remained intact, correlating write loss to concurrent review activity.
